description: Replace the panic-inducing unwrap() in fallback request handling with graceful error handling. When the fallback service is called more than once (violating the internal invariant), the system should return a 500 Internal Server Error response instead of panicking. In debug builds, this violation should trigger a debug assertion to help developers catch issues during development.
functional_requirements: Remove the unwrap() call from the fallback routing path that could cause panics
Implement graceful error handling that returns a 500 Internal Server Error response when the fallback service is called multiple times
Add debug_assert! logic that triggers only in debug builds to help developers identify invariant violations during development
Maintain the existing assumption that the fallback service should only be called once per request
Update routing tests to verify the new error handling behavior works correctly
